summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test (web preview 390x844, public URL) of the dynamic RevenueCat paywall / soft-paywall rework. ALL 10 REQUESTED FLOWS PASS. (1) Unauthenticated user (localStorage cleared) opening /subscription sees the AuthGate ('Create Account or Sign In'), not the paywall. (2) A fresh user went through the full onboarding (splash -> referral Skip -> questions -> 'Generate My Profile' -> generating screen), landed on /subscription?from=onboarding showing the AuthGate, and hera_onboarded was set to '"true"'. Signed in with a new OTP user (delivered+it31a...@resend.dev, code_hash overridden) -> fallback screen 'Plans are unavailable right now' with the buttons Continue to App, Try again and Restore purchases. No $12.99/$89.99/$7.50, no 'CHOOSE YOUR PLAN', no plan cards and no 'Paywall is not available' anywhere on /subscription. (3) Tapping 'Continue to App' goes to '/' (Home) and stays there: URL checked every 1s for 10s was only '/', with no bounce to /subscription. (4) Reloading '/' as an onboarded non-subscribed user goes to Home, not /subscription. (5) 'Try again': a MutationObserver saw the progressbar render (1 mutation) and then the fallback came back with no crash. However, no new network request reaches api.revenuecat.com because the RC SDK serves cached offerings, so the spinner only shows for about 1 frame. (6) Restore purchases on the fallback shows the in-app alert 'No Active Subscription / No active subscription was found for this account.'; the user stays on /subscription after OK. (7) In the Profile tab, the 'Hera Premium' row (right text 'Upgrade') and the 'Upgrade to premium' banner both open /subscription and go straight to the fallback, with no auth step. (8) AI chat as a free user with the daily count set to 5: the placeholder reads 'Daily limit reached — upgrade for unlimited'. Tapping the nudge or the send button calls showPaywall, which opens PaywallModal with the web fallback ('Hera Premium / Checkout is available in the Hera mobile app', Restore Purchases, Close). Restore in the modal shows the no-subscription alert, and Close returns to /chat. No crash. (9) Demo account: /login -> demo@heraapp.com -> Password/Code 1234 -> 'Sign In & Continue' -> Home, stable for 10s. Profile shows 'Active'. The Hera Premium row and a direct /subscription deep link both immediately route back to '/'. Reloading '/' -> Home. (10) Console: 0 errors in every run, no 'Maximum update depth'. The only 429 came from my own OTP-send rate limit (5 sends per 10 min per email), which is expected. The native RevenueCatUI.Paywall path was code-reviewed only (it can't render on web). The HAS_NATIVE_PAYWALL check matches the SDK's own internal PaywallView check (react-native-purchases-ui 10.11.0), which is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: refetchOfferings() resolves from the RevenueCat SDK offerings cache: no network request to api.revenuecat.com was sent on tap, and the spinner showed for only about 1 frame. Users get no visible feedback and the retry never re-fetches fresh data. Suggest a minimum spinner time (~800ms) and/or a short 'Still unavailable' message. Reference: /app/frontend/app/subscription.tsx:281-292

integration_issues.issue: When the offering has 0 packages, offeringsQuery refetchInterval polls every 15s for the whole session, even on Home or Chat (seen: 1 offerings request per 15s while idle). Consider polling only while the paywall is mounted, or capping the number of attempts. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:80-83

issues: The copy 'We couldn't reach the store' is inaccurate on web and when the store responds with an empty offering. Suggest more neutral wording such as 'Plans aren't available on this device right now'.
The fallback has no Terms/Privacy links. That is OK while no purchase is possible, but keep them on any purchasable surface (the RC remote template already provides them).

react_native_issues.issue: Metro warns: SubscriptionContext.tsx -> PaywallModal.tsx -> RevenueCatPaywall.tsx -> hooks/useSubscription.ts -> SubscriptionContext.tsx. This can cause uninitialized values. Reference: /app/frontend/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx:20

action_items: LOW: Remove the now-dead local paywall in onboarding.tsx (screen 25 render branch plus the hardcoded PLANS array with $89.99/$12.99/$7.50 at lines 614-616 and ~1046-1170). It is no longer reached from the normal flow (GeneratingScreen -> /subscription), but it is still bundled. It could appear if a stale resume-progress value points to screen 25, and it contradicts the 'no hardcoded paywall' requirement.
LOW: 'Try again' on the fallback: add a minimum spinner duration or a feedback message. The RC SDK returns cached offerings instantly.
LOW: Stop the 15s offerings polling outside the paywall, or cap the number of retries (src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:80).
LOW: Clean up unused imports and constants in subscription.tsx: Linking, IAP_SKUS, useMemo, SlideInRight, TERMS_URL, PRIVACY_URL.

LOW: Break the require cycle SubscriptionContext -> PaywallModal -> RevenueCatPaywall -> useSubscription, for example by passing restore via props or moving the PaywallModal render out of the provider file.
LOW: Add testIDs to the AuthGate email/OTP inputs and buttons, and to the web RevenueCatPaywall fallback (Restore Purchases / Close).
critical_code_review_comments: subscription.tsx: the old comment at lines 26-28 still says 'use the local paywall'. The local paywall is gone, so the comment should be updated.

RevenueCatPaywall.native.tsx: the loadError branch shows 'Paywall Unavailable' + Close, but onLoadError already makes the parent swap in the fallback, so that branch is effectively unreachable when used from /subscription. Harmless.

SubscriptionContext.showPaywall on native with empty offerings -> PaywallModal -> native RevenueCatPaywall -> onLoadError -> onViewPlans -> /subscription fallback. The chain is correct, but it briefly mounts a full-screen modal with a spinner before navigating.
